name: evalset-cite-01
description: Evaluation dataset (generation 1, migrated) for AskWRI Cite mode. Migrated 2026-08-12 from source_evalsets/cite-golden-dataset.json (v3.0, frozen reference covering the original 169-document corpus) into the generation-2+ schema (parallel expected_external_ids/expected_document_ids arrays). 2026-08-18: full reconciliation against the 206-doc corpus (documents-list_20260817.txt) -- all expected_document_ids resolved to real UUIDs; q4 additionally gained 2 new-refresh documents (Brazil climate adaptation/disaster docs); q5's one dead reference (a confirmed-removed duplicate) dropped; 7 documents previously pruned as 'not in catalog' in the 169-doc-corpus era, now confirmed back, re-added across q3/q6/q10/q11 (see metadata.note and each test case's own note for details). 2026-08-19: completed the deferred zh/es/pt cross-lingual-counterpart review across all 11 topics -- 6 zh/es documents (plus 1 confirmed en translation-twin) added across q1/q5/q10/q11 (see metadata.note and each test case's own note); no candidates found or added for q2/q4/q6/q7/q8/q9, no addition for q3. 3 of the added documents are flagged pending SME review (see notes).

test_cases.question: What have we published on land value capture?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve for papers that take land value capture (a sub-topic of urban planning) as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention thematic area – e.g. papers where those words show up in literature review, mentioned in discussion section, etc.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'topic_area' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'topic_discovery' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy). 2026-08-19: added 2 zh/es cross-lingual documents found during the deferred cross-lingual-counterpart review -- 2015_rail-plus-property-shenzhen_00032 (zh) (confirmed translation-twin) and 2020_acciones-federales-planeacion-urbana_0152 (es). 2026-09-04: updated after SME review, omitting one doc.

test_cases.question: What have we published on Bangalore?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a specific geography as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention geography tangentially.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'geography' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'geography_constrained' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: What have we published on children and pollution?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a thematic intersection as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention one or the other tangentially.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'thematic_intersection' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'thematic_intersection' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy). 2026-08-18: re-added Improving School Infrastructure for Healthier Students and Communities -- back in corpus now. 2026-09-04: added 2 candidate docs surfaced by Gorka's SME review of _4461 (ciencia-participativa-accion-para-un-aire-limpio_6722, fortaleciendo-sinergias-electromovilidad-calidad-aire_XXXX) -- NEEDS FURTHER SME REVIEW: added on Gorka's recommendation, but relevance to this query's 'primary focus' requirement not independently confirmed; the second doc has no extracted body text available (metadata/summary only).

test_cases.question: What have we published on climate adaptation in Brazil?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a thematic and geographical intersection as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention one or the other tangentially.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'thematic_geographic_intersection' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'geography_constrained' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy). 2026-08-18: added 2 documents from the 2026-08-17 corpus refresh (Bridging National and Local Climate Adaptation in Brazil/India/Indonesia -- top qmd vsearch hit, 0.75; Root Causes of the 2024 Rio Grande do Sul climate disaster -- 0.69), both confirmed substantively about Brazil-specific climate adaptation/vulnerability, not tangential mentions. All expected_document_ids now resolved (full Cite-01 UUID-reconciliation pass, 2026-08-18).

test_cases.question: How can cities implement micromobility solutions?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a not well-defined topic area (micromobility encompasses a range of technologies). Do not retrieve papers that clearly are about non 'micro', such as public transit, freight, and other non-mobility solutions.
test_cases.note: Removed enabling-shift-electric-auto-rickshaws (not in corpus). 2026-08-18: dropped 2021_mexico-frontrunners-creating-safe-affordable-and_6429 -- duplicate ingest of _5127, which remains and still covers this doc; no coverage lost. 2026-08-19: added 3 docs from the deferred cross-lingual-counterpart review -- 2020_dockless-bike-sharing_00124 (zh) (translation-twin), 2025_seguridad-de-motociclistas-infraestructura-vias-urbanas_0030 / 2025_motorcycle-safety-and-urban-road-infrastructure_8478. NEEDS SME REVIEW: this pair wasn't a counterpart of an already-included doc, and motorcycles are a debatable fit for 'micromobility' (usually excluded by vehicle class in most definitions, though this eval set already includes motorized autorickshaws as a precedent). Authorship reviewed 2026-09-04: Document included regardless of authorship affiliation.

test_cases.question: Will electrifying school buses be beneficial for children's health outcomes?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about the impact of an intervention on a population? Do not retrieve papers that are about the intervention (school bus electrification) without talking about the specific impact of interest.
test_cases.note: ImpactAr tool covers health impacts of bus fleet electrification, though not school buses specifically. query_type changed to 'thematic_intersection'. 2026-08-18: re-added Improving School Infrastructure for Healthier Students and Communities.

test_cases.question: What can be done to solve the housing crisis in Jakarta?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about solutions to a general thematic problem area within a determined geography. Do not retrieve papers that only cover theme or geography, and only retrieve papers that talk about solutions.
test_cases.note: Updated from negative test (0 expected) to include adjacent/related docs per user guidance. Surabaya is other Indonesia city, rest are global scope housing solutions. query_type migrated to 'topic_discovery'. Authorship reviewed 2026-09-04: Document included regardless of authorship affiliation.

test_cases.question: Have we published any papers or reports on hydrogen?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers about a niche topic. Do not retrieve papers that talk about broader energy/mobility topics and just tangentially mention the technology.
test_cases.note: First 2 are directly on hydrogen, last 2 include hydrogen in energy analysis. Removed completing-trip (not in catalog). query_type migrated to 'topic_discovery'.

test_cases.question: Give me all the papers that were published as part of the cities World Resources Report?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve all papers that were published within a specific, well-defined research program, our WRI Ross Center's flagship research initiative that ran roughly 2015-2021. Do not retrieve papers that cite the WRR or have similar topics but were not part of the official corpus.
test_cases.note: 16 papers total: 2 framing/synthesis, 7 thematic, 7 city case studies. query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'umbrella_program' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'membership' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: Have we published anything to do with urban finance since 2020?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve all papers that were published after a specific date on an amorphous intersection. 'Urban finance' is a concatenation of two amorphous terms and not thing as such, so expecting to return all things in our corpus to do with finance, which is mostly electric buses and transportation.
test_cases.note: Date filter: 2020 onwards. Removed 5 docs not in catalog, added back on 2026-08-18. query_type migrated to 'date_constrained'. FIXED 2026-08-13: removed 3 docs that predate the query's 'since 2020' cutoff (verified via date_published frontmatter). 2026-08-19: added 3 es docs from cross-lingual-counterpart review. 2020_acciones-federales-planeacion-urbana_0152 -- NEEDS SME REVIEW: year_published is 2020 with no exact month in the frontmatter.

test_cases.question: Have we published anything to do with urban finance – please exclude anything to do with electric buses?
test_cases.task_description: Variation on the previous question, asking to remove the dominant thematic intersection and removing the temporal cut off.
test_cases.note: Urban finance minus electric buses. 2026-07-22: removed 4 electric-bus KPS that contradicted the query's own exclusion clause (financing-electric-and-hybrid-electric-buses, assessing-financing-challenges-implementing-large-scale-electric-bus-program-india, rolling-out-electric-buses, the-future-of-urban-mobility-electric-bus-deployment-in-bogota-colombia). query_type migrated to 'topic_exclusion'. 2026-08-19: added the same 3 es docs as q10. Authorship reviewed 2026-09-04: Document included regardless of authorship affiliation.

metadata.note: Some expected docs removed from the original cite-golden-dataset.json (not in catalog, as of the 169-doc-corpus era). URL typo fixed: healthier-students-and-communities → healthier-communities. Pruned URLs missing from that era's corpus: improving-school-infrastructure-healthier-communities (q3, q6), Pathways-to-Decarbonize-the-Road-Transport-Sector-in-Guangdong (q8). 2026-08-13: removed 3 more from q10 that predated its 'since 2020' filter (date-filter bug inherited from cite-golden-dataset.json, flagged by Paul Lam) -- see q10's note. 2026-08-18: full reconciliation against the 206-doc corpus (documents-list_20260817.txt) -- all expected_document_ids resolved; 1 dead reference dropped (q5); 7 previously-pruned docs confirmed back in catalog and re-added (improving-school-infrastructure-healthier-communities to q3+q6, 5 finance/e-bus docs to q10, seizing-the-urban-opportunity to q11). The Guangdong doc (q8) and enabling-shift-electric-auto-rickshaws (q5) remain confirmed absent. 2026-08-19: completed the deferred zh/es/pt cross-lingual-counterpart review (previously flagged as open in both this file and expected_doc_expansion_plan_citemode_20260817.md) -- checked all 11 topics against the corpus's 52 non-English (34 zh/15 es/3 pt) documents, using documents-list_20260817.txt's has_translations/translation_of fields plus manual title triage and content verification (qmd vsearch under-ranked non-English docs against English queries, so was not relied on alone). Added 6 zh/es documents plus 1 confirmed en translation-twin across q1 (+2), q5 (+3, incl. the en/es motorcycle-safety pair), q10 (+3), q11 (+3; 2 of these 3 shared with q10, 1 shared with q1 -- see each test case's own note for full detail and which additions are the same underlying document). No candidates found for q2/q4/q6/q7/q8/q9; 2 es air-quality docs considered and excluded for q3 (children not a primary focus in either, confirmed by reading full text). 3 of the added documents (the motorcycle-safety es/en pair in q5, and 2020_acciones-federales-planeacion-urbana_0152 in q10/q11) are flagged NEEDS SME REVIEW pending human sign-off -- see each test case's note for the specific open question.
changes_from_v2: Ambiguous matches were all added, for human review, increasing the expected number of documents at least temporarily.

expected_document_ids uses documents.external_id, the same identifier the search service returns as doc_id (see search-service/app/pg_store.py — document_chunks.node_metadata.doc_id is populated from documents.external_id at ingest). Ambiguous urls (matching >1 document — confirmed duplicate ingests with identical url/date/title, different external_id suffix) include ALL candidate external_ids so recall isn't undercounted
changes_from_v1: Fixed Q6 expected_count (was 4 with note about null URL, now 4 with ImpactAr tool added)
Updated Q7 from negative test (0 expected) to include 4 related docs
Added Q9: World Resources Report (umbrella program, 16 papers)
Added Q10: Urban finance since 2020 (amorphous + temporal)
Added Q11: Urban finance excluding e-buses (amorphous + exclusion)
Skipped Q12: Major flagship publications (4 URLs missing from catalog)
metadata.query_type_migration_note: Original 11 cite-golden-dataset.json query_types were mapped onto evalset_cite_02.json's taxonomy on 2026-08-12: topic_area/fuzzy_topic/niche_technology/solution_focused all collapsed into topic_discovery (same relevance mechanic; fuzziness/niche-ness/solution-framing are topic-definition nuances, not independent constraint axes); geography/thematic_geographic_intersection collapsed into geography_constrained; amorphous_temporal renamed date_constrained. Three genuinely new axes were added to the shared taxonomy: thematic_intersection (topic x topic co-occurrence), membership (retrieval by named series/partnership/collaboration membership, broadened from the narrower 'umbrella_program' -- e.g. 'documents WRI wrote in partnership with X', not just report series), and topic_exclusion (renamed from amorphous_exclusion, 'X but exclude Y'). See expected_doc_expansion_plan_citemode_20260812.md for the full taxonomy table.
